concepts.name: water cycle
concepts.definition: The process describing how water moves between the atmosphere, land, and bodies of water.

concepts.name: ocean
concepts.definition: A large body of salt water that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: lake
concepts.definition: A body of water that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: river
concepts.definition: A flowing body of water that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: soil
concepts.definition: Ground material that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: groundwater
concepts.definition: Water stored underground in reservoirs.

concepts.name: snow
concepts.definition: Frozen precipitation that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: ice
concepts.definition: Frozen water that stores water in reservoirs.

concepts.name: evaporation
concepts.definition: The process changing liquid water into water vapor.

concepts.name: condensation
concepts.definition: The process changing water vapor back into liquid.

concepts.name: solar energy supply
concepts.definition: The provision of solar energy needed for evaporation.

concepts.name: water movement process
concepts.definition: The movement of water between the atmosphere, land, and bodies of water.

concepts.name: liquid to vapor change
concepts.definition: The transformation of liquid water into water vapor.

concepts.name: liquid water
concepts.definition: Water in its liquid state.

concepts.name: vapor to liquid change
concepts.definition: The transformation of water vapor back into liquid.

concepts.name: water vapor
concepts.definition: Water in its gaseous state.

concepts.name: humidity factor
concepts.definition: A condition affecting the rate of evaporation.

concepts.name: evaporation rate
concepts.definition: The speed at which evaporation occurs.

concepts.name: wind factor
concepts.definition: A condition affecting the rate of evaporation.

concepts.name: water availability
concepts.definition: The presence or absence of water affecting evaporation rates.

concepts.name: transpiration
concepts.definition: The specific process of releasing water vapor through stomata in plants.

concepts.name: evapotranspiration
concepts.definition: The combined process of evaporation from surfaces and transpiration by plants.

concepts.name: cloud
concepts.definition: A collection of tiny liquid droplets, ice crystals, or both.

concepts.name: plant root absorption
concepts.definition: The process by which plants absorb water through their roots.

concepts.name: water
concepts.definition: A substance absorbed by plants through their roots.

concepts.name: stomatal vapor release
concepts.definition: The release of water vapor from leaf openings called stomata.

concepts.name: water vapor (272523ab)
concepts.definition: Water in gaseous form released through leaf openings.

concepts.name: air transport of vapor
concepts.definition: The movement of air that transports water vapor.

concepts.name: air cooling and saturation
concepts.definition: The condition where air cools sufficiently and becomes saturated.

concepts.name: vapor condensation
concepts.definition: The process where water vapor condenses onto small particles to form droplets when air cools and becomes saturated.

concepts.name: small particles
concepts.definition: Tiny particles onto which water vapor condenses to form droplets.

concepts.name: tiny liquid droplets
concepts.definition: Tiny liquid droplets found within clouds.

concepts.name: ice crystals
concepts.definition: Tiny ice crystals found within clouds.

concepts.name: cloud particle growth
concepts.definition: The process where cloud particles increase in size until they are heavy enough to fall.

concepts.name: precipitation fall
concepts.definition: The event of water falling from clouds as precipitation.

concepts.name: water (6b225a36)
concepts.definition: Liquid water in its falling form (rain/snow).

concepts.name: water evaporation before ground
concepts.definition: The process where some falling water turns back into vapor before hitting the ground.

concepts.name: rain snow return
concepts.definition: The event of rain and snow returning atmospheric water to the surface.

concepts.name: atmospheric water
concepts.definition: Water vapor and liquid water present in the atmosphere.

concepts.name: precipitation
concepts.definition: Water falling from the atmosphere to the land surface.

concepts.name: land
concepts.definition: The terrestrial surface receiving precipitation.

concepts.name: infiltration
concepts.definition: The entry of water through the ground surface into soil or porous material.

concepts.name: soil structure
concepts.definition: The arrangement and configuration of soil particles and pores.

concepts.name: existing moisture
concepts.definition: Water already present in the soil before new precipitation arrives.

concepts.name: vegetation
concepts.definition: Plant life covering the land surface.

concepts.name: rainfall intensity
concepts.definition: The rate at which precipitation falls during an event.

concepts.name: percolation
concepts.definition: The deeper movement of water through the subsurface soil layers.

concepts.name: evaporation (5e1d8a7d)
concepts.definition: The process of water turning from liquid to vapor and leaving leaves.

concepts.name: surface flow
concepts.definition: Water moving over the ground surface after precipitation.

concepts.name: root absorption
concepts.definition: The process of water being taken up by plant roots from soil.

concepts.name: water in soil
concepts.definition: Water present within the soil matrix.

concepts.name: pore space retention
concepts.definition: Water remaining within the void spaces of soil.

concepts.name: groundwater recharge
concepts.definition: The process where water reaching the saturated zone contributes to groundwater storage.

concepts.name: groundwater (0f6e24d1)
concepts.definition: Water that fills pores or fractures in saturated material.

concepts.name: aquifer
concepts.definition: A geologic formation that stores and transmits usable quantities of groundwater.

concepts.name: spring
concepts.definition: A location where groundwater emerges at the surface.

concepts.name: stream
concepts.definition: A body of flowing water on the surface.

concepts.name: lake (1c351daa)
concepts.definition: A body of standing water on the surface.

concepts.name: watershed
concepts.definition: land area that drains surface water toward a common outlet

concepts.name: river (e1ab0bf7)
concepts.definition: watercourse carrying water downstream

concepts.name: lake (11b34797)
concepts.definition: body of water that temporarily stores surface water

concepts.name: wetland
concepts.definition: area that temporarily stores surface water and influences timing of movement

concepts.name: snow (d27a6191)
concepts.definition: frozen precipitation that stores water

concepts.name: ice (ca7c0452)
concepts.definition: frozen water that stores liquid potential

concepts.name: stream (6414b061)
concepts.definition: channel receiving released water from melting snow/ice or runoff

concepts.name: soil (b8028efa)
concepts.definition: ground material that can receive liquid water

concepts.name: water budget
concepts.definition: A comparison of inputs, outputs, and changes in storage within a defined area and time interval.

concepts.name: groundwater (1939c456)
concepts.definition: Water stored underground in aquifers.

concepts.name: sustained withdrawals greater than replenishment
concepts.definition: The condition where water extraction exceeds natural or artificial recharge rates.

concepts.name: groundwater storage reduction
concepts.definition: The decrease in groundwater storage resulting from sustained withdrawals greater than replenishment.

concepts.name: percolation (901cb26d)
concepts.definition: The downward movement of water through soil and rock layers under the influence of gravity.

concepts.name: surface runoff generation
concepts.definition: The process where water flows over the land surface rather than infiltrating, occurring when precipitation exceeds infiltration capacity or soil saturation.

concepts.name: soil saturation
concepts.definition: A state where all pore spaces in the soil are filled with water, preventing further infiltration.

concepts.name: stomatal vapor release (787b1c59)
concepts.definition: The process of water vapor exiting plant leaves through open stomata.

concepts.name: infiltration limitation
concepts.definition: The restriction of water entry into soil due to low permeability, high saturation, or surface sealing.

concepts.name: surface sealing
concepts.definition: The formation of a hydrophobic or compacted crust on soil surface that prevents water entry.

concepts.name: aquifer saturation
concepts.definition: The state where pore spaces in an aquifer are fully filled with water, preventing further downward movement of recharge.
